summary: Phase A validation PASS (13/13 backend tests green). Verified: EUR currency labels frontend-wide, Rodrigo→Besord legal swap, mascot/icon assets at correct sizes, campaign create still works with new Request param, audit row written to db.campaign_audit, new GET /api/admin/campaigns/{id}/audit endpoint returns correct shape and enforces admin role (401 without token, 403 for non-admin, 200 for admin). Stripe security audit: items a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, j all PASS; item i (webhook) is a known gap. Found and fixed one minor bug: client_ip in campaign_audit was always None because get_client_ip(request) was passed a Request object instead of dict(request.headers). Patched line 864 of server.py.

minor.issue: `image_sha256` field in campaign_audit truncates SHA-256 hex to 32 chars (server.py:863). Field name says sha256 but value length matches MD5. Functionally harmless for dedupe but misleading. Suggest rename to `image_hash` or store full 64-char digest.

No Stripe webhook configured. Reconciliation depends entirely on user returning to the success_url and the client polling /check-payment. If the user closes the tab after paying, the campaign stays in `pending_payment` until manually checked. Mitigate before public launch.

Tier field returned by /api/business/tiers and consumed in frontend is still named `amount_usd` even though all displays/payments are EUR. Cosmetic/naming inconsistency only — values are correct. See pricing.py and frontend/app/business/campaign/new.tsx:127.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo web console emits repeated warnings: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Replace shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset/elevation with the unified boxShadow API to silence warnings and stay forward-compatible.

stripe_security_audit.a_api_key_from_env: PASS — server.py:28 reads STRIPE_API_KEY from os.environ; fallback string `sk_test_emergent` is only used to flag mock mode, not as a real key. .env contains a real `sk_test_51RZJD...` key.
stripe_security_audit.b_currency_eur_unit_amount_integer: PASS — server.py:826-827 hardcode `currency: "eur"` and `unit_amount: final_amount_cents` (int). Same in renewal flow line 1205.
stripe_security_audit.c_amount_server_side: PASS — final_amount_cents derived from TIERS[payload.tier_key].amount_cents (server.py:761) with promo discount applied server-side (lines 777-780); client cannot inject price. Stripe minimum 50¢ floor enforced.
stripe_security_audit.d_success_cancel_url_server_controlled: PASS — server.py:812-813 built from APP_BASE_URL env + campaign_id; not user-supplied.
stripe_security_audit.e_repoll_payment_status: PASS — check_campaign_payment (server.py:894-897) re-fetches the Stripe session and asserts `session.payment_status == "paid"` before activation. URL query `?paid=1` is not trusted by itself.
stripe_security_audit.f_ownership_enforced: PASS — campaign queries scope by `user_id`: server.py:877 (check-payment), other endpoints similarly. Confirmed by test_campaign_ownership_enforced (admin user gets 404 trying to fetch another user's campaign via /business/campaigns/{id}).
stripe_security_audit.g_promo_server_side_validation: PASS — server.py:765-781 verifies code lookup, `active != false`, `expires_at`, `max_uses` vs `uses`, `discount_pct` all from db.promo_codes; client only submits the code string.
stripe_security_audit.h_metadata_carries_campaign_user: PASS — server.py:837 metadata = {campaign_id, user_id, tier_key, promo_code}; payment_intent metadata also has campaign_id (line 838).
stripe_security_audit.i_no_webhook: NOTE / KNOWN GAP — No /stripe/webhook endpoint exists. Without webhook, asynchronous reconciliation (paid users that never return) is impossible. Add stripe.Webhook.construct_event with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and an /api/stripe/webhook route before public launch.
stripe_security_audit.j_mock_fallback_gated: PASS — is_mock_key check (server.py:814 and 889) only triggers when api_key in ("sk_test_emergent", "", None). Real `sk_test_*` keys bypass mock. Confirmed by backend logs showing real stripe.com API calls during tests.

action_items: (Optional) Rename `image_sha256` field in campaign_audit to `image_hash` or store full 64-char digest (server.py:863).
(Pre-launch) Add Stripe webhook endpoint /api/stripe/webhook with signature verification (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) for async payment reconciliation.
(Cosmetic) Rename tier field `amount_usd` → `amount_eur` across pricing.py + frontend usages to match the EUR pricing now displayed.
(Cleanup) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow across screens to clear Expo web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1528 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Plan to split into auth.py, business_campaigns.py, posts.py, admin.py, promos.py modules.
Pattern `__import__("hashlib").sha256(...)` (server.py:863) — prefer a top-of-file `import hashlib`. Minor style.
campaign_audit collection has no index on campaign_id; add `db.campaign_audit.create_index('campaign_id')` for the admin audit endpoint to stay fast as data grows.
seed_data_creation: Test seeds an admin session for rodrigocontecunha@gmail.com directly in db.user_sessions; teardown removes it. Business test user is created+deleted per run. All test campaigns/audit rows cleaned up.

Stripe security audit is documented in this iteration — main agent should focus on (1) adding Stripe webhook before public launch, (2) splitting server.py, (3) renaming amount_usd→amount_eur. Iteration 6 fixed one latent bug (client_ip always None in audit). Real Stripe test mode is active (sk_test_51RZJD...) — mock path only runs when key literally equals sk_test_emergent.
rca_of_issue: Audit row client_ip was always None because get_client_ip() expects a dict of headers but server.py:864 was passing the entire FastAPI Request. Because Starlette's Request is a Mapping over `scope` (not headers), the .get() calls inside get_client_ip silently returned None instead of raising. Fixed by wrapping with dict(request.headers), matching the convention used elsewhere in server.py (lines 481, 521, 625, 1273).
